Description: Fix notice signatures mobile layout in student dashboard
Instruction: Modify the inline style block to force the signatures-section to display as a row instead of a column on mobile devices

ReplacementChunks.ReplacementContent: .signatures-section { flex-direction: row !important; flex-wrap: nowrap !important; justify-content: space-between !important; padding-top: 30px !important; }
ReplacementChunks.TargetContent: .signatures-section { flex-direction: column !important; gap: 40px !important; align-items: flex-start !important; padding-top: 30px !important; }
